newsitem.title: UK: London platinum fixes at lowest since Jan 31, '94.
newsitem.headline: London platinum fixes at lowest since Jan 31, '94.

text.p: Platinum fixed at $385.25 per ounce on Thursday, its lowest fixing since January 31, 1994.
Its previous recent low was on September 23 when it was set at $386.50, the lowest since April 20, 1994.
At its morning fixing on Thursday, it was fixed at $387.25, down a dollar from Wednesday afternoon.
Dealer said the market was currently oversupplied and that consumers preferred to run down stocks rather than buy in what they saw as a weakening market.
